_comment: bd init writes a SessionStart 'bd prime --hook-json' hook here. It is deliberately absent: the global hook in ~/.claude/settings.json runs 'bd prime --mcp' for every repo, and most beads repos on this machine have no project hook at all. Two hooks means two copies of the prime output per session. If a full-length beads block reappears at session start, bd re-added it here.
